projects.title: Selected work
projects.intro: Most of my commercial code is under NDA, so here I describe what I built and why it mattered.

featured.name: Project setup automation
featured.summary: A Python tool that downloads a website, localizes its assets and links, and turns it into a clean project ready for development.
featured.detail: Every new project used to start with hours of copying and fixing files by hand. I designed and built this tool on my own initiative, and now the team starts from a working project in minutes.

featured.name: Landing pages for a business school
featured.summary: Responsive landing pages for the marketing campaigns of Alex Yanovsky Higher School of Management.
featured.detail: I connected payment gateways and third-party APIs, built a set of reusable components so new pages launched faster, and tuned performance, SEO and cross-browser support.

about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a web developer from Ukraine, now living in Hagen. I build websites and web applications and automate the processes around them: routine tasks, integrations between services and internal tools for the team. I started with landing pages for marketing teams, where every second of load time costs sales, so performance and clean code matter to me. Automation grew from the same idea: if something is done by hand again and again, it should be done by code.
